profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
profile.summary: Highly accomplished Infrastructure Engineer with 8+ years of experience in migrating and building highly scalable, high performance infrastructure using automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to streamline deployments and significantly enhance system reliability and efficiency. Adept at utilizing monitoring tools for proactive performance analysis and rapid troubleshooting and experienced in resolving critical production issues through collaborative on-call support.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
• Led key workstreams for an end-to-end migration of Rancher Kubernetes clusters and databases from on-premises to Google Cloud under budget and ahead of renewal deadline securing savings of over $100,000. 
• Engineered and maintained a suite of standardized Terraform modules, reducing manual configuration errors by over 90% and ensuring consistent, repeatable infrastructure provisioning across multiple GCP environments.
• Spearheaded critical infrastructure security and compliance efforts, directly contributing to a successful SOC2 audit by designing and testing disaster recovery failover strategies, conducting quarterly RBAC reviews, and managing the remediation of audit findings.
• Managed and resolved high-priority production incidents as a part of a 24/7 on-call rotation, improving overall system uptime by 15% through proactive quarterly maintenance and security upgrades.
• Collaborated with development teams to build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, leveraging GitLab, Helm, and ArgoCD to automate application delivery to GKE clusters and increase release velocity by 30%.
• Authored and maintained comprehensive technical documentation, including infrastructure diagrams and runbooks, to standardize operational procedures across a team of 15+ engineers.

positions.title: Network Infrastructure Specialist II
positions.description:
• Managed over 1000 VMware servers in two data centers consisting of both Windows and Red Hat Enterprise Linux using VSphere client 6.7
• Utilized Ansible and custom Ansible playbooks/modules to deploy quarterly patches, security patches, and firmware updates on both Windows and Red Hat Linux servers
• Wrote Terraform module using Bash script to attach and create physical volumes, logical volumes, and volume groups to newly provision Linux servers
• Used Splunk queries to triage network connectivity and troubleshoot
• Commissioned and deployed Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7) servers using Red Hat Satellite 6.5.3 and custom DNS BIND configurations
• Administered user account access and group roles across production, development, and staging Linux environments using CVS repository
• Implemented firewall policy changes across multiple inter-zones (development, web, and production) using Junos Space Security Director 19.4 R1.3
• Configured networked storage (SAN/NAS) via NetApp on both Windows and Linux servers

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Set up and configure laptops for employees using System Center Configuration Manager.
• Responsible for dispatch, first-level service and support and asset management within corporate  ITSM using ServicePro
• Responsible for tape backup administration for US corporate data center using Symantec NetBackup
• Maintain company infrastructure services such as: Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft Lync, and Cisco Unified Call Manager.
